indicator_legend.Pivot_Supertrend: Trail-stop trend filter. 'Up Trend' value = support trail (price above = bullish). 'Down Trend' value = resistance trail (price below = bearish). Flip = trend change.
indicator_legend.7-Star_Confluence: Composite score 0-7. ≥6 = strong directional conviction. 5 = developing. ≤4 = weak/no edge.
indicator_legend.Laguerre_RSI: 0-1 range. <0.15 = oversold (long entry zone). >0.85 = overbought (short entry zone / no-chase). 0.15-0.85 = mid-zone, wait. Long Entry / Short Entry flags = 1.0 means signal triggered this bar.
indicator_legend.Hurst_Smooth: >0.6 = persistent trending regime. 0.4-0.6 = neutral. <0.4 = mean-reverting. Higher = stronger trend memory.
indicator_legend.Choppiness_norm: <0.3 = clean trending market. 0.3-0.5 = mixed. >0.5 = sideways/choppy — trend signals unreliable, skip.

bullish: Pivot Supertrend in Up Trend mode AND price > trail level
Laguerre RSI < 0.15 (oversold) OR fresh cross-up from below 0.15 OR Long Entry flag = 1.0
STRONG BUY = all 5 conditions met. NORMAL BUY = 4/5 with Conf ≥ 6 mandatory.
bearish: Pivot Supertrend in Down Trend mode AND price < trail level
Laguerre RSI > 0.85 (overbought) OR fresh cross-down from above 0.85 OR Short Entry flag = 1.0
STRONG SELL/SHORT = all 5 conditions met. NORMAL SELL = 4/5 with Conf ≥ 6 mandatory.
neutral: OR Choppiness > 0.5 (sideways market — trend signals untrustworthy)
OR Laguerre RSI in mid-zone 0.15-0.85 with no fresh cross
OR Pivot Supertrend just flipped within last 1-2 bars (wait for confirmation)
Action: stand aside, no new positions
avoid_chasing: Long: do NOT enter if Laguerre RSI > 0.80 even with strong trend — wait for pullback to <0.15
Short: do NOT enter if Laguerre RSI < 0.20 even with strong downtrend — wait for bounce to >0.85
Reason: entering at extreme RSI = buying tops / selling bottoms

long_setup: ENTRY: Lag RSI crosses up through 0.15 with Conf ≥6, in Up Trend, Hurst >0.6, Chop <0.4
STOP: just below Pivot Supertrend trail level (Up Trend value)
TARGET 2: trail with Pivot Supertrend until flip
short_setup: ENTRY: Lag RSI crosses down through 0.85 with Conf ≥6, in Down Trend, Hurst >0.6, Chop <0.4
STOP: just above Pivot Supertrend trail level (Down Trend value)
TARGET 2: trail with Pivot Supertrend until flip
skip_if: Spread between price and Supertrend trail < 0.5 ATR (stop too tight)

exit_rules: Hard stop: Pivot Supertrend flip (close beyond trail line) — exit full position
Trail stop: ratchet stop to Supertrend trail as it advances, never loosen
Partial profit: take 50% at Target 1, let 50% trail
Time stop: if no progress after 5 bars at default_timeframe, close at breakeven
Confluence break: if Conf drops from ≥6 to ≤4 while in trade, tighten stop
risk_rules: Risk per trade: max 1% of account equity
Sector cap: max 2 positions in same SET sector (BANK, ENERGY, RETAIL, etc.)
Daily loss limit: -2% of account → stop trading rest of day
Weekly loss limit: -5% → reduce size by half next week
After 3 consecutive losses: skip next signal regardless of setup quality
Position sizing: size = (account × 1%) / (entry - stop), round down to lot

regime_filter.SET_index_check: Before any single-name long, check SET on same timeframe. If SET Pivot Supertrend = Down Trend AND Hurst >0.6, only take longs with Conf = 7/7. Reverse for shorts.
regime_filter.macro_overlay: If SETHD/SETWB diverge from SET by >2% over 5 days, prefer the stronger basket — reduce conviction on laggards

notes: Universe = SET100 + core watchlist. Default TF = Daily (swing). Indicators: Pivot Point Supertrend [SET], 7-Star Confluence Dashboard, Laguerre RSI Ehlers [SET], Hurst Choppiness [SET] Regime. CPR Camarilla used as discretionary support/resistance overlay. Run `tv analyze brief-output.json` to interpret scan results offline.
